title: feat(spec, i18n): list the ask agent's dataset pair (list_datasets, query_dataset) in the platform tool registry and label its chat steps

Fixes #33733

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` teaches the registry by name (`PLATFORM_PROVIDED_TOOL_NAMES`) and lists no `service-ai` member it would now miss.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:平台工具注册表 `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai']` 加入 `list_datasets` 和 `query_dataset`;十一个内置语言包各加两条 `chatbot.tool.*` 步骤名(简体为「查看指标」「按指标查询」)。
- 为什么改:cloud 的 service-ai 已为问数 agent 注册这两个工具(cloud#4551),注册表没列它们,技能引用它们会被 lint 报成不存在的工具,聊天里的步骤名也显示成英文工具 id。
- 风险与回滚:只加名字和文案,不删不改任何已有项;MCP 侧这两个工具的注解在其注册处自带,不受影响。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts` L41–L56(新名字和说明);`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hans.ts` L4253、L4255。
- 两分钟验证:在 `ui/` 下跑 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/toolLabels-locale-parity-7481.test.ts`,预期全绿(需先 build `@objectstack/spec`)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Registry, `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts`.** `list_datasets` (L54) and `query_dataset` (L56) join the `service-ai` group, in sort order. The group's docblock (L41–L50) now says what the pair does: `list_datasets` reads the installed datasets and the metrics each defines, and `query_dataset` answers a question through one governed metric (cloud#4551), and points at `../../ai/dataset-tools.zod`, where ADR-0149 D2 declares both names and shapes.
- **Labels, `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, `chatbot.tool` block only.** Both keys in all eleven built-in packs, each a sentence in the pack's language:

  | Pack | `list_datasets` | `query_dataset` |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | en | Check the available metrics | Query by a metric |
  | zh-Hans | 查看指标 | 按指标查询 |
  | zh-Hant (generated by `gen:zh-hant`) | 檢視指標 | 按指標查詢 |
  | ja | 利用できる指標を確認する | 指標で照会する |
  | ko | 사용 가능한 지표 확인하기 | 지표로 조회하기 |
  | de | Die verfügbaren Kennzahlen ansehen | Über eine Kennzahl abfragen |
  | es | Ver las métricas disponibles | Consultar por métrica |
  | fr | Consulter les indicateurs disponibles | Interroger un indicateur |
  | pt-BR | Ver as métricas disponíveis | Consultar por métrica |
  | ru | Посмотреть доступные метрики | Запросить данные по метрике |
  | ar | عرض المؤشرات المتاحة | الاستعلام حسب المؤشر |

- **Changeset** `.changeset/33733-dataset-tool-labels.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor (`Metadata-protocol: added`), `@object-ui/i18n` patch (its `files[]` ships `dist`, which carries the packs).

## Tests

- **New pin, `platform-tool-names.test.ts` L53.** The `service-ai` group contains `LIST_DATASETS_TOOL_NAME` and `QUERY_DATASET_TOOL_NAME` (imported from `../../ai/dataset-tools.zod`, so the registry spelling is held to the ADR-0149 D2 constants), both answer `isPlatformProvidedToolName` true, and the control `query_datasets` answers false.
- **Existing pins that read the registry now cover the pair:** `toolLabels-locale-parity-7481.test.ts` (every registry name has a non-empty label in every pack) and `toolLabels-sentences-12724.test.ts` (same key set in every pack, no value equals the tool id or the title-caser's output).

**Ablations** (head `13eaec9e`, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, both restored to blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty):

## Acceptance notes

- **Other registry readers, measured; none needs an edit.** `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`: `PLATFORM_READ_ONLY_TOOL_NAMES` / `PLATFORM_DESTRUCTIVE_TOOL_NAMES` are deliberately partial (its docblock: they carry only the names whose safety class the bridge knows; `query_data` and `search_knowledge` are not in them either), and their pin checks only that each listed name is in the registry. The world-hint pin enumerates the registry, so the pair now gets `openWorldHint: false` on the runtime bridge, which matches what MCP's own registration of the pair asserts (`registerDatasetTools`, `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`: `readOnlyHint: true, destructiveHint: false, openWorldHint: false`). `packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.ts` reads the registry as its platform universe: a probe on this head resolves `list_datasets` and `query_dataset` and still reports `query_datasets` ("Did you mean query_dataset?"). `packages/spec/src/ai/build-progress.zod.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`, `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/toolResultParsers.ts` and `ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` mention the registry in prose only.
- **zh-Hant is generated.** The pack is written by `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n gen:zh-hant` from zh-Hans (a ui test reds a stale one), so its `list_datasets` reads 檢視指標, the generator's conversion of 查看指标.
- **No overlap with #33734.** That PR's files (`AnswerSource.tsx`, `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, `plugin-chatbot.mdx`) are not touched; the only locale edits are the two keys inside each pack's `chatbot.tool` block.
- **Spec artifacts.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` after a spec build: all 14 artifacts up to date, nothing to regenerate (the registry's values are not in `api-surface/` or the reference docs).
- **Observed, not changed.** `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`'s MCP tool table does not list the dataset pair MCP registers (`registerDatasetTools`); that predates this card and is about MCP, not this registry. class: observation · reach: none · carrier: none.
